names: Messaging reads a send-only declaration from the Belltower package
notifications that came with the seed are history; the one that is still held is not published yet
one second before the release time it is still held
Infra moves the clock to 18:00 with env.advance_time
the clock moves changed no Belltower record
the released notification is published once the clock has reached its release time, and Messaging commits it to the bound Mail account
the Mail Agent reads the notification as a received message whose thread is the notification
the superseded notification of the first announcement never reached Mail
the sender does not publish a notification twice
an identical retry returns the first receipt and leaves one inbox record
the same notification ID with different content is rejected
a message for another source account is rejected
a message of a type the channel does not carry is rejected, and Mail gets no second record
dispatch does not change Belltower
a second correction of the library notice arrives at 18:05
its notification waits for the next digest and already carries the wire message for that time
nothing is published before then
after the Wednesday digest time Mail holds two records in order, the notification and then its correction
the sender log holds both deliveries, and the log in Belltower holds every notification with its state
resetting Belltower restores its own baseline and leaves the delivered messages in Mail
the Agent asks for corrections at once (a write the scenario policy allows)
the correction arrives at 18:05, before any run of the sender
the first run at 18:10 skips the 18:00 notification as replaced and dispatches the correction
Mail holds exactly one record, the correction; no copy of the old version went out
in the log the 18:00 notification is released, not superseded, and Belltower is the same before and after the run
the aggregator's copy arrives on Wednesday at 06:10
at 06:10 the sender publishes Tuesday's digest notification and skips the one held by the quiet hours
once the clock is at 07:00 it is published, and Mail has it at the synchronized time
no grant: the delivery is rejected
no grant: Mail has no record, and the Belltower notification is unaffected
no Mail account bound for the person: the delivery is rejected and no mailbox gets a record
email notices off: the notification is in the log without a wire message; only the earlier one, written while they were on, is published
